newsitem.title: USA: Brazil food retailer files for US share offering.
newsitem.headline: Brazil food retailer files for US share offering.

text.p: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao, Brazil's largest food retailer filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to three million American depositary shares representing three billion preferred shares.

Each share will represent 1,000 non-voting preferred shares, of which three million will be offered initially in the United States and Canada and 1.75 million will be offered outside the US, Canada and Brazil.

The company is concurrently offering 1.75 billion preferred shares in Brazil. Existing preferred shares are listed on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange and the company has applied to list the American depositary shares on the New York Stock Exchange, according to the SEC filing.
Global coordinators for the offering are Merrill Lynch & Co, Banco BBA Creditanstalt S.A. and Paribas. Underwrtiers for the U.S. offering are Merrill Lynch & Co. and Paribas, according to the filing.

Proceeds from the sale will be applied to the company's capital expansion and investment plan, including opening new stores, remodeling existing stores, increasing warehouse space and improving distribution.
